ValidationRule.description: Address ID expiry Date field is mandatory if Nationality equals Bahrain
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Bahrain"), ISBLANK(Address_ID_Expiry_Date__c), OR( RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAF', RecordTypeId='0121t000000IVAG' ), NOT(ISBLANK(ID_Expiry_Date__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the Address ID expiry Date field to proceed
